title: Food Randomizer
summary: A website that  helps you pick what you would like to eat at random.
body:
I have had this project on my mind for a long time and it is one of those ones where you just sit and wonder what problems you face and one of the ones I face every now and then is deciding on what to eat. 

So that is why I came up with this particular solution I will still improve along the line so stay tuned.
